title: BRIAR: Martingale Belief Smoothing on Bifurcation-Guided Reasoning Trees
abstract: arXiv:2611.34746v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has rapidly advanced long-chain reasoning, yet standard policy optimizers distribute rollout compute and gradient credit blindly across a trajectory. On hard problems, an early misstep derails the remaining trace, whereas on solvable problems, the policy keeps generating redundant verification long after the answer is already determined. We trace both pathologies to a single structural fact: under an on-policy verifier, the true prefix pass probability $V^\pi(u)$ along a reasoning trace forms a $[0,1]$-bounded Doob martingale whose learnable credit variance is strictly conserved and bounded above by $V^\pi(u)(1-V^\pi(u))$, vanishing at both the derailed ($V^\pi\to 0$) and absorbed ($V^\pi\to 1$) boundaries. We introduce BRIAR (Bifurcation-guided Rollout and Inference on Adaptive Reasoning trees), a tree-structured RLVR framework built directly around this martingale geometry. First, B

translated_title: BRIAR：分叉引导推理树上的鞅信念平滑
translated_abstract: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已迅速推动了长链推理的发展，然而标准的策略优化器在整条轨迹上盲目地分配采样计算量与梯度信用。在困难问题上，早期的失误会使剩余的推理轨迹脱轨；而在可解决的问题上，即使答案早已确定，策略仍会继续生成冗余的验证。我们将这两种病态追溯到同一个结构性事实：在策略内验证器下，推理轨迹上的真实前缀通过概率 $V^\pi(u)$ 构成一个取值于 $[0,1]$ 的 Doob 鞅，其可学习的信用方差被严格守恒且上界为 $V^\pi(u)(1-V^\pi(u))$，并在脱轨（$V^\pi\to 0$）与吸收（$V^\pi\to 1$）两个边界处消失。我们提出了 BRIAR（基于自适应推理树的分叉引导采样与推理），这是一个直接围绕该鞅几何结构构建的树状 RLVR 框架。首先，B（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出BRIAR框架，利用推理轨迹上前缀通过概率构成有界Doob鞅、其信用方差在脱轨与吸收边界处消失这一鞅几何特性，通过分叉引导的树状采样与推理，解决长链推理中困难问题早期失误脱轨和可解问题冗余验证的两大病态。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BRIAR, a tree-structured RLVR framework built on the Doob martingale geometry of prefix pass probability, using bifurcation-guided rollout and inference to address both early derailment on hard problems and redundant verification on solvable ones in long-chain reasoning.
